We need to generate test cases for getObjectMapper(InputFormat). The method has three branches: if InputFormat.JSON -> getJsonMapper(); else if InputFormat.YAML -> getYamlMapper(); else throw IllegalArgumentException.

We need test cases covering each branch. Also need to test that IllegalArgumentException includes the unsupported format.

We need to provide input parameters: InputFormat enum values. We need expected output: an ObjectMapper instance, maybe same as returned by getJsonMapper/getYamlMapper. Since those are protected/package-private methods, we may need to mock or spy the JsonSchemaFactory to control them. In unit test, we can subclass JsonSchemaFactory to override getJsonMapper/getYamlMapper to return known mock objects, enabling verification.

Thus test cases:

Group: getObjectMapper

Case 1: input JSON -> expect jsonMapper (mock) returned.

Case 2: input YAML -> expect yamlMapper returned.

Case 3: input null? Actually InputFormat is enum; passing null leads to IllegalArgumentException? The code checks InputFormat.JSON.equals(inputFormat) which will NPE if inputFormat null? Actually equals called on enum constant, safe; equals(null) returns false. Then second else if also false, then throws IllegalArgumentException with "Unsupported input format null". So test null case.

Case 4: unsupported enum value? InputFormat only has JSON and YAML; maybe there is other values? If more, but we can test a dummy enum value using mock? Not possible. So null case covers else branch.

Thus produce JSON.

Structure: each case includes input list with parameter name and value. Parameter name likely "inputFormat". Value: "JSON", "YAML", null.

Expected: maybe "jsonMapperInstance" etc. We can describe as "ObjectMapper instance returned from getJsonMapper". For exception case, expected: "IllegalArgumentException with message containing 'Unsupported input format null'".
